name: Popados
overview: Three teenagers get their hands on gas cutting equipment. Having decided to make money, the boys, without permission, take the car of a neighbor policeman and go to an abandoned construction site to cut and scrap an old tower crane. However, the crane falls on the car of the leader of the criminal group, who has just shot a trucker in front of their eyes. Trying to escape, the friends get into an accident and crash the car. What seemed like a profitable business is becoming the beginning of a whole series of problems.
